verdict.rationale: Fly.io offers only narrow, built-in event-to-action behaviors: a Machine restart policy that defines how flyd restarts a Machine when its process exits, Sprites that wake when needed, and scale-out when traffic arrives. There is no evidence of a general user-defined rules or trigger engine, and a community user notes that even cron-like scheduling is missing from the platform. Missing for 10: a general event-rule/trigger configuration system, scheduled/cron triggers, event-driven hooks or notifications to arbitrary actions, and independent corroboration.
